items.problem: The bootstrap omitted linked shared project items and the validator disagreed with the initializer's empty deferred sentinel.
items.evidence: lessons.json dev_agent_struggles[1] and errors_encountered entries for duplicate types, missing Styles.xaml crash, and deferred warning; skill-defects.json items 0 and 4.
items.root_cause: Filesystem-only inventory ignored MSBuild Link metadata, and the bootstrap/validator empty-state contract was inconsistent.
items.change: Resolve linked Compile/ApplicationDefinition/Page/Content/AppxManifest items into their Link paths before rewrite/triage, and accept the generated '(none)' deferred sentinel.
items.expected_effect: Shared shell XAML, styles, code, and branding enter the mapping automatically; no manual reconstruction, missing-resource crash, or false deferred warning.
items.falsifiable_check: On the UserInfo source, bootstrap reports 17 resolved linked items and copies App.xaml, MainPage.xaml, Styles\Styles.xaml, and branded assets; validator emits no empty-deferred warning.

items.problem: Operational and threading guidance caused an unsupported build command, parallel file-lock failures, and ambiguous DispatcherQueue compilation.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors for winapp build, input.json/CS2012/WMC9999 locks, and CS0104; skill-defects.json items 1-2; skill-coverage-gaps.json item 0.
items.root_cause: The prose named the wrong compiler command, did not prohibit parallel dependent operations, and showed an unqualified replacement type.
items.change: Use explicit x64 dotnet build, require serialized scaffold/bootstrap and build/launch/validation operations, and fully qualify Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue when Windows.System is in scope.
items.expected_effect: The first compile runs successfully against the intended project without command rejection, orchestration races, or DispatcherQueue ambiguity.
items.falsifiable_check: A rerun contains no 'winapp build', Target-not-found race, input.json/CS2012 lock, or DispatcherQueue CS0104 error.

items.problem: All behavior passed but every feature scored partial because scaffold theme, title, and placeholder icon replaced source identity.
items.evidence: migration-score.json features[0..2], discrepancies.json visual items, and skill-defects.json item 3.
items.root_cause: Shell conversion lacked identity invariants and manifest guidance preferred scaffold assets.
items.change: Require preservation of RequestedTheme and source display name across Window/custom TitleBar, prefer resolvable source branding, and reject scaffold title/icon placeholders.
items.expected_effect: Migrated shell identity matches the source instead of silently adopting template defaults.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, the app launches dark, shows 'User Info C# Sample', and has no UserInfo/AppIcon.ico placeholder; the three visual partial verdicts can become pass.
